name: Investment Fund Fee 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of service for which a fee e is asked or paid.

BEND.name: Back End Load
BEND.definition: Fee paid by the investor to the fund or fund management company when redeeming.

BRKF.name: Brokerage Fee
BRKF.definition: Fee paid to a broker for services provided.

CBCH.name: Correspondent Bank Charge
CBCH.definition: In investment funds, the charge of the correspondent bank for transferring money.

DLEV.name: Dilution Levy
DLEV.definition: In investment funds, a charge payable by the investor covering bid-offer spreads and dealing charges for the underlying investments. The dilution levy is paid to the fund for the benefit of other unit holders.

FEND.name: Front End Load
FEND.definition: Fee paid by the investor to the fund or fund management company when subscribing.

INIT.name: Initial Charge
INIT.definition: Charge paid at the time of the first subscription.

PREM.name: Premium
PREM.definition: In investment funds, pre-arranged addition to the trade amount based on the published net asset value.

CHAR.name: Service Provision Fee
CHAR.definition: Fee paid by the investor to a distributor/intermediary or other service provider for the provision of financial services.

SWIT.name: Switch
SWIT.definition: In investment funds, charge related to a switch transaction.

UCIC.name: UCITS Commission
UCIC.definition: Charges paid by the investor to the fund company for subscription and redemption orders.

COMM.name: Commission
COMM.definition: Amount paid out by the fund to a third party.

SHIP.name: Shipping Charge
SHIP.definition: Charge for shipping, including the insurance of securities.

CDPL.name: Commission De Placement
CDPL.definition: Amount of cash due to an intermediary for selling a product, or services, to a third party.

ADDF.name: Additional Fee
ADDF.definition: Additional fee not covered by another fee type.

REGF.name: Regulatory Fee
REGF.definition: Fee charged by a regulatory authority, for example, securities and exchange fees.

PENA.name: Penalty
PENA.definition: Fee charged to the investor for early redemption of the fund.

NTWK.name: Network Fee
NTWK.definition: Network fee assigned to a transaction on a DLT network.
